CAPTION

Four of these are the apps everyone recommends. Number 2 is the one that uploads your footage to your own cloud while you're still rolling — so a phone that gets taken, smashed or dropped in a river doesn't take the shoot with it. I built that one, so weigh it accordingly.

Which is on your home screen?

#filmmaking #iphonefilmmaking #blackmagiccamera #kino #filmicpro #finalcutcamera #applelog #prores #documentary #cameraapps

Export each artboard as PNG from the toolbar — they're 1080×1920, TikTok photo-mode size. Post in canvas order, 1 through 7.

The four dashed tiles are placeholders. Grab each icon from its App Store listing, save it into the repo folder under the name below, and re-run build-slides.py — it picks them up automatically.
